About the Opportunity  

 A mixed billing clinic located in the centre of the fast growing community of Beaconsfield is needing a part-time female VR GP to cover Obs/Gynae and GP shared care. Special interests in cosmetic medicine is a bonus as there will be an opportunity to learn and upskill in injectables etc with the principal GP. The premises has a really nice fitout that looks good and feels good with onsite parking and public transport nearby, this position is ideal for working mothers who are looking for around 20 hours a week! We look forward to hearing from interested candidates.  

  Essential Criteria:  

 
	 MBBS or equivalent

	 FRACGP qualified 
	 Medical Indemnity Insurance

 Our client is an award winning, doctor owned mixed billing medical practice located only 15km from the Adelaide CBD. Servicing the local Aldgate community for 30 years, this clinic has recently been refurbished with the latest equipment and IT infrastructure required for their team of general practitioners, practice nurses, counsellors, speech and hearing rehabilitation professionals, nutritionists and sleep disorder practitioners to provide the best possible care to their patients.
